name: The Hunter
objective: Someone else is hunting the Frostbells: Sigrun, a monster hunter who destroys relics rather than collect them. She wants the bell you carry.
intro: She has been tracking you since the Keep. She does not draw her weapon. She draws your attention to the claws of her Absol.
dialogue: Hunter Sigrun: "You're the one who beat Krampus. Good. Then you'll understand when I take that bell off you."
Hunter Sigrun (defeated): "...Strong. And soft. That softness will get someone killed."
lore_discovery: Sigrun's family sealed the Frostbells generations ago. She believes the bells must be destroyed, not hidden — and that keeping them makes the player a target.
